academic-writing.studentFacing: You can see how academic writing is different from the way you write every day.
academic-writing.academic: Recognise how academic writing differs from everyday writing.
academic-writing.groundedIn: academic writing differs from everyday writing

academic-writing.studentFacing: You can build paragraphs that open with a clear topic sentence.
academic-writing.academic: Write paragraphs led by topic sentences.

academic-writing.studentFacing: You review your own writing against the criteria, and this is making you a more independent writer.
academic-writing.academic: Review one's own writing against criteria to grow as an independent writer.
academic-writing.groundedIn: for own development: self-review against criteria makes one an independent writer

academic-writing.studentFacing: You can see that what tutors expect follows conventions you can learn.
academic-writing.academic: Understand that tutors' expectations follow learnable conventions.
academic-writing.groundedIn: tutors' expectations follow conventions that can be learnt (academic socialisation)

academic-writing.studentFacing: You can adapt how you write to different types of assignment.
academic-writing.academic: Adapt writing to different assignment types.

academic-writing.studentFacing: You can see your writing voice as part of the graduate you are becoming.
academic-writing.academic: See one's writing voice as part of one's graduate identity.
academic-writing.groundedIn: for own development: one's writing voice is part of one's graduate identity

academic-writing.studentFacing: You can write in your subject's voice and keep one argument going across a whole piece.
academic-writing.academic: Write in the subject's voice with a sustained argument.
academic-writing.groundedIn: writes in the discipline's voice with a sustained argument

academic-writing.studentFacing: You can see writing as where you work out your authority and your place in your subject.
academic-writing.academic: Understand writing as where disciplinary identity and authority are negotiated.
academic-writing.groundedIn: writing is where identity and authority in a discipline are negotiated (academic literacies)

academic-writing.studentFacing: You treat writing as a professional capability you keep developing beyond your degree.
academic-writing.academic: Treat writing as a professional capability to keep developing.
academic-writing.groundedIn: for own development: writing is a professional capability one keeps developing

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can notice when an answer from an AI tool looks wrong.
ai-technology.academic: Notice when an AI answer looks wrong.
ai-technology.groundedIn: notice when an answer looks wrong

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can see that AI works by generating likely patterns of text, not by knowing things.
ai-technology.academic: Understand generative AI as pattern generation, not knowledge.
ai-technology.groundedIn: AI is pattern generation, not knowledge

ai-technology.studentFacing: You notice that leaning on AI too much can wear away your own voice.
ai-technology.academic: Recognise that over-reliance on AI erodes one's own voice.
ai-technology.groundedIn: for own development: over-reliance erodes one's voice

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can explain how generative AI produces text, and why it sometimes makes things up.
ai-technology.academic: Explain how generative AI produces text and why it fabricates.
ai-technology.groundedIn: explain how generative AI produces text and why it fabricates

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can see that AI only adds to your thinking when your own ideas come first.
ai-technology.academic: Understand that AI augments thinking only when one's own thinking leads.
ai-technology.groundedIn: AI augments thinking only when one's own thinking comes first

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can see being a discerning user of AI as part of the graduate you are becoming.
ai-technology.academic: See discerning AI use as part of one's graduate identity.
ai-technology.groundedIn: for own development: being a discerning AI user is part of graduate identity

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can use AI critically and selectively, bringing it in only where it genuinely helps.
ai-technology.academic: Use AI critically and selectively on study tasks.
ai-technology.groundedIn: uses AI critically and selectively and discloses it

ai-technology.studentFacing: You can see that using AI with integrity takes judgement, not just following the rules.
ai-technology.academic: Understand integrity in AI use as judgement as well as rules.
ai-technology.groundedIn: integrity in AI use is a matter of judgement as well as rules

ai-technology.studentFacing: You adapt the way you use AI to the purpose of each professional setting.
ai-technology.academic: Adapt one's AI practice to each professional purpose.
ai-technology.groundedIn: for own development: one's AI practice is adapted to each professional purpose

creativity.studentFacing: You can see that most questions have more than one good answer.
creativity.academic: Recognise that most questions have more than one valid answer.
creativity.groundedIn: there is more than one way to answer most questions

creativity.studentFacing: You can name the things that get in the way of your own creativity.
creativity.academic: Name one's own barriers to creativity.
creativity.groundedIn: name one's own barriers to creativity

creativity.studentFacing: You can see being flexible as part of how you learn.
creativity.academic: See flexibility as part of how one learns.
creativity.groundedIn: for own development: flexibility is part of how one learns

creativity.studentFacing: You can bring creative and critical thinking together on the same task.
creativity.academic: Connect creativity and critical thinking within a task.
creativity.groundedIn: connect creativity and critical thinking in a task

creativity.studentFacing: You can see that new ideas often come from combining things that already exist.
creativity.academic: Understand that new ideas often come from combining what exists.
creativity.groundedIn: new ideas often come from combining what exists

creativity.studentFacing: You can see creativity as part of the graduate you are becoming.
creativity.academic: See creativity as part of one's graduate identity.
creativity.groundedIn: for own development: creativity is part of one's graduate identity

creativity.studentFacing: You can look at a problem from another angle, or from another subject, to open it up.
creativity.academic: Reframe a problem from another angle or discipline.
creativity.groundedIn: reframe a problem from another angle or discipline

creativity.studentFacing: You can see that a creative idea needs to be both new and useful, judged within its field.
creativity.academic: Understand that creativity requires novelty and usefulness, judged in a domain.
creativity.groundedIn: creativity needs novelty and usefulness, judged in a domain

creativity.studentFacing: You adapt your creative practice to the purpose of each professional setting.
creativity.academic: Adapt one's creative practice to each professional purpose.
creativity.groundedIn: for own development: one's creative practice is adapted to each professional purpose
